name: PixelSelect (GPIO design selector)
author: joeskolengaden
description: Pick the running show with GPIO switches. Each toggle switch owns its own set of designs; a shared pushbutton steps through whichever set is switched on. A design is an xLights sequence or an FPP playlist, and the selected one loops until the button is pressed again or the switch is released. Pins, wiring polarity, debounce and order are all configured in the plugin's own UI, which also shows both inputs live and can act as a virtual pushbutton for testing before anything is wired.

settingsSchema.label: Plugin enabled
settingsSchema.help: Master switch. When off the GPIO pins are ignored and the plugin never touches playback.

settingsSchema.label: Software override
settingsSchema.help: Behave as if a switch were closed. For testing before the switches are wired.

settingsSchema.label: Software override applies to
settingsSchema.help: Which set the software override stands in for. 0 = the first switch.

settingsSchema.label: Enable pin (toggle switch)
settingsSchema.help: The toggle pin for the FIRST set of designs, mirrored from config/pixelselect_sets.tsv. Extra sets each get their own switch; edit them on the plugin page. Blank means the plugin never takes over playback unless virtual_enable is set.

settingsSchema.label: Enable switch closes to ground
settingsSchema.help: True for a switch wired between the pin and GND (the usual case).

settingsSchema.label: Enable pin resistor
settingsSchema.help: gpio_pu = internal pull-up, gpio_pd = pull-down, gpio = none/external.

settingsSchema.label: Next pin (pushbutton)
settingsSchema.help: FPP pin name for the momentary pushbutton that advances the design.

settingsSchema.label: Button closes to ground
settingsSchema.help: True for a button wired between the pin and GND.

settingsSchema.label: Button pin resistor
settingsSchema.help: gpio_pu = internal pull-up, gpio_pd = pull-down, gpio = none/external.

settingsSchema.label: Debounce
settingsSchema.help: How long an input must hold steady before it counts. Raise it if one press advances two designs.

settingsSchema.label: Loop the selected design
settingsSchema.help: Repeat the selected sequence or playlist until something changes it.

settingsSchema.label: Wrap around
settingsSchema.help: Pressing next on the last design goes back to the first.

settingsSchema.label: Remember the last design
settingsSchema.help: When the switch goes on, resume the design that was selected last (survives a reboot).

settingsSchema.label: Override whatever else is playing
settingsSchema.help: While the switch is on, take the player back from anything else that grabs it - a schedule, a remote, or someone pressing play in the FPP UI. Turn it off to let other things win once they start.

settingsSchema.label: Return to the schedule when the switch opens
settingsSchema.help: After letting go of the player, ask FPP's scheduler to look again so a scheduled playlist that is still inside its time window resumes. FPP will not do this on its own once another playlist has owned the player.

settingsSchema.label: Keep it playing
settingsSchema.help: If playback stops while the switch is still on, start the selected design again.

settingsSchema.label: When the switch goes off
settingsSchema.help: now = stop immediately, graceful = finish the current item, afterloop = finish the current loop.

settingsSchema.label: Long press does
settingsSchema.help: none = act on press. Anything else makes a short press act on release so a long press can be told apart.

settingsSchema.label: Long press time
settingsSchema.help: How long the button must be held to count as a long press.
